resolvedP0Defects.title: Storefront Publication Predicate False in Real PostgreSQL
resolvedP0Defects.rootCause: Unescaped '\s+' in Prisma.sql template string in lib/storefront/sql-store-publication.ts evaluated to 's+' in PostgreSQL regexp_replace, replacing every letter 's' with a space and corrupting the SHA-256 pickup fingerprint digest.
resolvedP0Defects.resolution: Replaced '\s+' with POSIX bracket expression '[[:space:]]+' across all pickup address normalization fields.
resolvedP0Defects.verification: tests/integration/storefront-search.integration.test.ts (1/1 passed) and tests/integration/storefront-publication-withdrawal.integration.test.ts (3/3 passed) on real Docker PostgreSQL.
